app.name: Mon Ardoise
app.tagline: Forecast the costs and income of your rental properties
app.disclaimer: Projections rest on the assumptions you enter. They are neither financial advice nor a valuation.

auth.loginIntro: A Google account is all you need. No password to remember.

home.guestBody: Loan, upfront costs, recurring costs, rent: a month-by-month projection over twenty years, and the only number that really matters. What it takes out of your pocket every month.
home.previewCaption: Example: a €245,000 flat, a 20-year loan, €950 rent a month.
home.pillarLoanBody: Instalment, interest, capital repaid, month by month until the last payment.
home.pillarCostsBody: Notary and works upfront, property tax and upkeep every year. One-off costs are never spread out.
home.pillarRentBody: Lease, indexation, rent collected and arrears.
home.emptyBody: Add your first property: the home, the loan, the target rent. You get a first set of figures before entering a single cost.

property.newIntro: Three sections. Only the first is required; the loan and the rent can wait.
property.includeLoan: This property has an outstanding loan
property.includeLease: This property is rented, or will be
property.dangerHint: The property, its loans, leases and cost lines are permanently deleted.
property.tabRentDisabled: No lease on this property: nothing is expected, so nothing to tick off.
property.tabEditDisabled: Read only: only editors can change the settings.

members.title: Members
members.hint: The role grants access, the share splits the money. A friend with read access holds no share.
members.roleOwnerHint: Everything, including members, settings and deleting the property.
members.roleEditorHint: Entering and editing content, without touching members.
members.ownershipShareHint: As a percentage of the property's value.
members.contributionShareHint: What feeds your “share” column: what the property actually costs you.
members.ownershipTotalOff: Ownership shares total {total}. They should add up to 100%.
members.lastOwner: Last owner of the property: one is required, so the role is locked.
members.inviteEmailHint: When filled in, only that address can accept the invitation.
members.pendingHint: No email is sent: copy the link and pass it on yourself.

join.title: Invitation
join.unknown: This invitation code does not exist. Check the link you were sent.
join.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
join.used: This invitation has already been used.
join.wrongEmail: This invitation is addressed to someone else and does not match your account.

fields.name: Property name
fields.loanConventionsHint: Advanced settings. The defaults are those of Belgian mortgages. Only change them if the bank's amortization table says otherwise.
fields.rateBasisHint: Read it off the bank's amortization table, never assume it
fields.label: Label
fields.capitalize: Spread this amount over several years
fields.currentValueHint: What the property is worth today, not what you paid
fields.valueGrowthRateHint: Leave at 0 to assume no appreciation. This is an assumption, not a fact.
fields.natureUpfront: Upfront: notary, agency, works to make it rentable
fields.natureUpfrontHint: Counts towards the acquisition cost, so towards what a sale has to give you back. You will never pay it again, so it is not counted as a charge for the year.
fields.natureOneOffHint: A replaced boiler, a repair. It leaves your cash in the month given and weighs on your monthly effort, but does not repeat.
fields.natureRecurringHint: Insurance, property tax, maintenance, management fees. This is the only case that weighs on your monthly effort year after year.
fields.endDateIgnored: No effect on a one-off cost
fields.horizonYearsHint: Counted from your earliest entered date, and extended to the end of the calendar year. A 20-year horizon on a property bought in 2023 therefore stops in 2043, not 20 years from today.

summary.noRent: No rent on this property: the projection only counts costs
summary.linesEmpty: No line yet. Add the property tax, insurance, maintenance.
summary.loansEmpty: No loan. The property is financed with your own funds.
summary.leasesEmpty: No lease. No rent enters the projection.
summary.propertyValue: Estimated value at end of horizon
summary.propertyValueFlat: No growth assumed: the value stays the one you entered
summary.propertyValueGrown: Assumed growth of {rate} per year, applied through {year}
summary.netWorthHint: Estimated value {value} minus outstanding balance {debt}, in {month}
summary.oneOffAheadHint: One-off costs in the next 12 months: notary, works. Not spread, because you do not pay them in twelfths.
summary.equityBuiltHint: The principal repaid inside your instalment. It leaves your cash but enters your net worth; it is not an expense.
summary.netAfterLoansHint: What the property will bring in each month once the loans are repaid, in {month}
summary.netAfterLoansNever: The loans run beyond the horizon
summary.netWorthNowHint: Estimated value {value} minus outstanding balance {debt}. Does not deduct what already left your pocket.
summary.cashInvestedHint: Purchase price and upfront costs, minus what was borrowed: what you put in on the day of the purchase. This figure never moves again; the monthly effort added since is counted in « Gain if you sell ».
summary.timelineAllHint: Click a year to unfold it month by month. Two years are marked: the one where selling starts to pay off, and the one where the loan ends.
summary.sayCost: This property costs you <amount>{value}</amount> a month.
summary.sayEarns: This property brings you <amount>{value}</amount> a month.
summary.sayLose: If you sold today, you would lose <amount>{value}</amount>.
summary.sayGain: If you sold today, you would gain <amount>{value}</amount>.
summary.sayAheadFrom: From <amount>{value}</amount>, selling would give back everything you put in.
summary.sayAlreadyAhead: Since <amount>{value}</amount>, selling gives back everything you put in.
summary.sayNeverAhead: Within the projection horizon, selling would never give back everything you put in.
summary.chartCaption: What a sale would leave you, year by year.
summary.cashInjectedHint: The down payment, the costs and the monthly effort accumulated since day one. This is what a sale has to give back before you are ahead.
summary.totalCreditCostHint: Interest and insurance over the whole term of the loan. Unlike principal, they never come back.

common.invalid: Incomplete form: fix the highlighted fields.

rent.title: The tab
rent.intro: What the tenant has paid, month by month, and what is still owed.
rent.outstandingHint: Expected minus received, on months due up to and including {month}
rent.overdue: {count, plural, =0 {Up to date} one {# month overdue} other {# months overdue}}
rent.noLease: No lease on this property, so no rent is expected. Add a lease from the summary.
rent.nothingDue: The first expected rent is later than today. Nothing to record yet.
rent.expectedDueHint: Running total since the lease started. This figure does not move when you record a payment.
rent.advanceHint: Received for future months · {total} received in total
